about: Step machine of a client session unload: created by the unload game state's Enter (bg3.exe+0x18679F0), advanced by the per-frame update of ecl::SessionUnloadSystem (bg3.exe+0x18B4D00, 10 states) which removes the component in the last state.

evidence.says: Creator bg3.exe+0x1867B70 zeroes; bg3.exe+0x18679F0 stores the game state's this pointer; in state 9 bg3.exe+0x18B4D00 writes 1 to byte +0x28 of the pointed object (marks the state done) before removing the component.

Creator zeroes (8-byte store at +8). bg3.exe+0x18B4D00 sets it to 1 after each state step; while 1 it counts FramesWaited and resets to 0 after 5 frames, and the switch on State runs only when it is 0.
Incremented each frame while Waiting == 1, compared with 5 (bg3.exe+0x18B4D00).
Creator zeroes (4-byte store at +0x10); bg3.exe+0x18B4D00 switches on it (cases 0..9) and writes the next state as a 4-byte store.

survey.live_reason: no live or captured instance: needs a situation that creates it
open_questions: Waiting may be a wider enum than a flag (only 0/1 seen).
